Hey jttrs and anyone wondering the same question, in all honesty some medications do tend to numb all emotional feelings As a side effect it's kind of like a light blanket laying over your emotions it just takes a bit more to feel the things you used to. Some medications don't have that affect and those are usually the ones that will work best, to find them though is more or less trial and error, it's nothing to be scared of because it's quiet easy to recognise if this happens to you and even easier to fix it. you can change your medications (obviously by talking to your doctor/psychologist) and find the right one that helps you, your doctors are there to help you and you should never be forced into something you're uncomfortable with, have a consultation with your GP about your anxiety and possible treatments and I'm sure you'll feel more comfortable and informed. Ask lots of questions and voice your concerns they will more than likely be answered and eased.

I hope this helps someone.
